title: Build the reduced solver and keep the real action-stack error
statement: For V=span(U,b), acquired ||Y-B(theta)V||<=sigma, H=alpha I+sym(V*Y)>= (mu-sigma)I is actually solved. With tau=mu epsilon/(1+epsilon),sigma=tau/16, acceptance ||b-alpha x-Yz||+sigma||x||<=tau||x|| proves relative full-vector solution error<=epsilon. Failure earns a raw image Yz/||x|| separated from U by g=tau-2sigma. This cached combination is a valid bounded-error action but NOTan independent sample. Each changed normalized temporary b component is prepared/requeried after enrichment; subtracting noisy Bb then dividing by a tiny norm is not allowed. Zero b is handled separately. The warranted coercivity is not learned by observing H. Statistical sources need one charged joint/anytime confidence event,not a free fixed per-call probability over an infinite stream.

requires: Unknown FIXED Hermitian primitives B_j, known norm bound L, actual chosen full-vector actions with ||error||<=delta||v|| at requested delta. Source reports need not be linear or independent.
Later adaptive A(theta)=alpha I+sum theta_j B_j has real sum|theta_j|<=1 and known A>=mu I; mu is supplied/earned from the input class, not inferred from a small compression.

Low-enrichment conclusion needs width of encountered task-action images at fixed epsilon/mu; unknown subspace/rank are analysis parameters, not learner advice. Correct acceptance does not require the width premise.

Column tolerance scales as sigma/sqrt(cache capacity); declared price delta^-p gives O_p(k sigma^-p[(R+1)^(1+p/2)+T(R+1)^(p/2)]). This is a proxy, not time/energy/sample count.
Storage O(knR), full-vector projections/output and reduced dense solves/QR paid. Squared Hermitian primitives use two original actions with propagated errors/preparation paid.
